facts.event: Elise 一夜未眠，在麻木与暴怒间反复，用拳头砸门，但 Tilde 的守卫始终不为所动；她为 Hein 和 Tilde 担惊。
facts.relation: Elise 与 Tilde 的守卫对立；她牵挂在押的 Hein 与 Tilde
facts.anchor: Elise had not slept. She had veered between numbness and rage.

facts.event: Elise 认定弟弟 Conrin 背叛父亲、密谋夺权，并意识到真正被蒙蔽、被自己的痛苦弄瞎的是她自己。
facts.relation: 姐弟：Elise 看穿 Conrin 的谋反
facts.numbers: ‘a sin of the mind, of the tongue, of the body’
facts.anchor: He had turned on their father, conspired against him, a sin of the mind

facts.event: Elise 握着天鹅梭子来回踱步，骂 Tilde 是‘愚蠢、愚蠢的姑娘’，她腹痛、手在流血、心已碎。
facts.relation: Elise 与 Tilde：女王/敌人/情人/朋友四重关系
facts.anchor: ‘You stupid, stupid girl,’ Elise hissed, pacing with her swan shuttle clutched between her fingers.

facts.event: Elise 看见低矮宫墙上竖起一面灰旗，主街上一小队披 Galen 甲、着灰罩袍的骑士在父亲的胜利雕像下集结。
facts.relation: Galen 骑士团 / 灰旗与父亲雕像
facts.anchor: a grey flag had been raised on the low palace walls

facts.event: 祭司 Dagobert 骑着过大的白马、举着折翼天鹅旗，罩袍外披锁甲，指挥众人收集木柴准备点信号火。
facts.relation: Dagobert 祭司：曾斥责 Elise、向 Conrin 进谗言
facts.numbers: ‘a shining white stallion of ridiculous size’
facts.anchor: riding a shining white stallion of ridiculous size, carrying the banner of the swan with the folded wings, was Dagobert

facts.event: Elise 在狂怒中用梭子划过挂毯，割断蓝白丝线与天鹅的喙和羽翼，多年忍辱与期盼尽毁。
facts.relation: 挂毯＝家族（母亲/兄弟/父亲）的象征，被 Elise 亲手毁掉
facts.numbers: Years; ‘a dead mother, a murdered brother and a broken heart’
facts.anchor: In a flash of agonised fury, Elise swiped the shuttle across the threads.

facts.event: Elise 听见喊声跑到窗边：东门蓝衣卫兵正与人争执，一名年轻侍从指着灰旗高喊，随即被城门上射下的一箭射倒。
facts.relation: 国王的蓝衣卫 vs 城墙上灰衣守卫；侍从示警被杀
facts.anchor: An arrow felled him from the top of the gates, and his warning was cut short.

facts.event: Elise 推断 Conrin 会把黑卫队等对手关进营房，于是不再躲藏，抄起织毯凳砸碎自己卧室的窗玻璃。
facts.relation: Elise 由旁观者转为行动者；Conrin 关押竞争者
facts.anchor: She picked up her carding stool, littered with pieces of the broken tapestry
